items.title: Request timeout decreased and maximum attempt count increased
items.before: fetch_with_retry configures a 30-second timeout (timeout_seconds = 30) and performs a single attempt (max_attempts = 1) without retrying on timeout.
items.after: fetch_with_retry configures a 5-second timeout (timeout_seconds = 5) and performs up to 4 attempts (max_attempts = 4), retrying on TimeoutError before giving up.

summary: Updated retry configuration in fetch_with_retry by reducing per-request timeout from 30 seconds to 5 seconds and increasing maximum attempts from 1 to 4.
